Introduction

JiYeon is a South Korean singer and dancer under MODHAUS.

JiYeon was introduced as the twenty-fourth and last member of the girl group tripleS on April 4, 2024. She debuted with the group on May 8, 2024, with the release of the album "ASSEMBLE24".

As a member of tripleS, JiYeon was placed in the sub-units Glow, Visionary Vision, Alphie, and Moon.
